title: API 版本策略对比：URL 版本（/v1/articles）vs 媒体类型/Header 版本（Accept: application/vnd...v2+json），同一请求双策略路由
expected_output:
request GET /v1/articles headers={}
  url_strategy    version=v1 handler=v1.listArticles params={} cache_key=/v1/articles note=matched
  header_strategy version=v1 handler=v1.listArticles params={} cache_key=/articles note=matched
request GET /v1/articles/9 headers={}
  url_strategy    version=v1 handler=v1.getArticle params={"id":"9"} cache_key=/v1/articles/9 note=matched
  header_strategy version=v1 handler=v1.getArticle params={"id":"9"} cache_key=/articles/9 note=matched
request GET /v3/articles headers={}
  url_strategy    version=v3 handler=- params=null cache_key=/v3/articles note=no such route in v3
  header_strategy version=v1 handler=v1.listArticles params={} cache_key=/articles note=matched
request GET /articles headers={"accept":"application/vnd.articles.v2+json"}
  url_strategy    version=- handler=- params=null cache_key=/articles note=no /vN prefix
  header_strategy version=v2 handler=v2.listArticles params={} cache_key=/articles note=matched
request GET /articles/9 headers={"accept":"application/vnd.articles.v2+json"}
  url_strategy    version=- handler=- params=null cache_key=/articles/9 note=no /vN prefix
  header_strategy version=v2 handler=v2.getArticle params={"id":"9"} cache_key=/articles/9 note=matched
request GET /articles headers={}
  url_strategy    version=- handler=- params=null cache_key=/articles note=no /vN prefix
  header_strategy version=v1 handler=v1.listArticles params={} cache_key=/articles note=matched
request GET /articles/9 headers={"api-version":"v9"}
  url_strategy    version=- handler=- params=null cache_key=/articles/9 note=no /vN prefix
  header_strategy version=v9 handler=- params=null cache_key=/articles/9 note=no such route in v9
